news.title: ‘Plants get sick!’: WashU scientists, U. City students research plants together
news.summary_en: Biologist Rachel Penczykowski, in WashU Arts & Sciences, is an expert in infectious disease in plants. She conducts much of her research in the field — rural farmland, urban parks and, on this sunny day, a garden bed at Jackson Park Elementary School in the University City School District.

news.title: What mice and crayfish can teach us about evolution
news.summary_en: By studying two very different animals, biologist Andreas Kautt in WashU Arts & Sciences is uncovering the genetic changes that help species adapt and diversify.
